question: Purushottam Dadheech, the Padma Shri Awardee 2020, is a renowned dancer and choreographer from Indore in the dance form:
solution:
The correct answer is** __Kathak.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of India's** highest civilian honours,** the **Padma Awards** are presented every year on the** evening of Republic Day.** Three types of awards are given: the **Padma Vibhushan **(for exceptionally and distinguising service), the **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of higher level), and the **Padma Shri** (distinguished service).
 
• **Kathak dancer** **Purushottam Dadheech **was born on July 17, 1939.
 
• He is an Indian classical dance choreographer and teacher who is renowned for his** innovative work in the Kathak genre.**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh (U.P.) is where the Kathak dance** first appeared in North India. This dance's name, **Katha, means "story," and throughout the entire performance,** the dancers use their eyes and facial gestures to tell stories. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​A dance from **Tamil Nadu in southern India is known as bharatanatyam**. It has its roots in the** Natyashastra**, a prehistoric book on theatre that the** mythical priest Bharata wrote. **Bharatanatyam, which was originally a dance performed by** women in temples,** is frequently utilised to convey** Hindu religious tales and devotions.**
 
• The addition of singing sets** Kuchipudi, which is native to the state of Andhra Pradesh**, apart from the other five classical dance forms. The dance-drama** Bhama Kalapam, which tells the tale of Satyabhma**, the alluring but envious wife of the god Krishna, was created in the 17th century by** Sidhyendra Yogi,** and is credited with giving rise to kuchipudi. 
 
• A significant type of classical Indian dance is** kathakali. The extremely colourful make-up**, costumes, and face masks that the traditionally male actor-dancers wear set this** "story play" kind of art apart. **
